---
title: Numbering by chapter
author: Test Author
crossref:
  chapters: true
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: article
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: With crossref.chapters, typst-extras numbers the figures and equations of a mcanouil article by section (Figure 2.1, (1.1)), on top of the numbering.typ partial of Quarto, which the mcanouil partials keep.
        check: bash _checks/extras.sh chapters
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['#let equation-numbering = "\(1\)"[\s\S]*#let equation-numbering = typst-extras-wrap\(equation-numbering']
---
